content.short: Supermojo provides a buy now, pay later financing option for NFTs.
content.description: Supermojo offers a buy now, pay later (BLNP) financing system for NFTs. Users can purchase NFTs and pay over a set period, with no interest or extra fees. While payments are in progress, the NFT is placed in Layaway until it is fully paid. After full payment, the NFT can be kept in the Supermojo wallet or transferred out.
content.meta: Supermojo is a buy now, pay later system for purchasing NFTs. Discover Supermojo and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
